title: A Rainy Reflection

segments.text: Here’s today’s Sapiver Press puzzle comic.
Rain streaks the window nook while Isla prepares for a busy midweek of work and packing.
The interruption changes the timing, not the whole shape of her morning.
She pauses between bookshelves, letting one useful idea settle instead of rushing into another half-finished thought.
Killer changes the move, so Isla checks the rule before trusting it.
The checked move holds, and the rest of the day has more room.
She closes the laptop with one decision carried forward.
